items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Jordan Walsh was in Duncanville, Texas this weekend to host his third annual youth basketball camp.

He spoke with Chris Forsberg about his contract extension.

As he said at Summer League, he later reiterated a goal of his is to "redefine myself offensively."
